How the bb-plugin-hermes v1 works

Long image

A

Answer

Each chat with an enabled Hermes bot becomes a bb thread. bb sends through the Hermes gateway's queue, so bb and Conduit share one conversation.

  1. A plugin bridge on the Hermes machine carries each bb chat to the gateway; replies stream back live.1
  2. bb and Conduit add turns to the same Bot Chat; bb waits instead of forking when Conduit holds it.2
  3. Chats started in CLI, TUI, Desktop or Conduit appear in bb by themselves.3
  4. One switch per bot turns all of this on, including the bot's access to bb.4

Applies toThe v1 plan for any Hermes user. Bot names are examples.

1

What runs where?

Diagram structure
  • bb app app
  • bb server bb
  • Plugin server server
  • Plugin bridge bridge
  • Host worker worker
  • Hermes gateway gateway
  • Bots bots
  • Saved chats saved
  • app → bb · message · reply
  • server → bb
  • server → worker · host calls
  • bb → bridge · turn · reply
  • bridge → gateway · send · stream
  • worker → gateway · watch · REST
  • gateway → bots · runs turn
  • gateway → saved · saves
  • The plugin has three parts: a server part on the bb server, and a host worker plus one bridge per open chat on the Hermes machine.1
  • The worker and each bridge have their own connection to the gateway. History reads go through Hermes' REST projection.5
2

How do the other Hermes apps connect?

Diagram structure
  • Conduit conduit
  • Dashboard dashboard
  • Desktop desktop
  • Saved chats saved
  • Gateway gateway
  • CLI / TUI cli
  • conduit → dashboard · sends
  • dashboard → saved · runs, saves
  • dashboard → gateway · if busy
  • desktop → gateway · sends
  • gateway → saved
  • cli → gateway · sends
  • Conduit reaches Hermes through the dashboard. The dashboard runs Conduit's turn itself, or hands it to the gateway queue when the chat is busy.
  • Desktop, CLI and TUI run every turn in the gateway.6
3

What happens in a chat from bb?

Diagram structure
  • You send send
  • Gateway queue queue
  • Bot runs it run
  • Reply streams stream
  • Bot asks ask
  • Card + push card
  • You answer answer
  • Turn goes on goon
  • send → queue · send
  • queue → run · runs
  • run → stream · streams
  • run → ask · may ask
  • ask → card
  • card → answer
  • answer → goon · answer
  • You pick a bot, a model and a reasoning level. The bot stays fixed for the whole chat.7
  • Approvals and questions show as a card in bb and send a push. bb never approves for you.
4

How does Stop work?

Diagram structure
  • You tap Stop tap
  • Turn stops stop
  • Shows stopped shown
  • Outside turn outside
  • Reply shows later
  • tap → stop · bb can stop
  • stop → shown
  • tap → outside · can't stop
  • outside → later · keeps running
  • Stop works on bb's own turns and on Conduit messages handed to the gateway queue.8
  • Other outside turns keep running; bb shows "Running outside bb".
5

How do bb and Conduit share one Bot Chat?

Diagram structure
  • bb sends bbsend
  • Conduit sends csend
  • Dashboard dash
  • Gateway queue queue
  • Saved chat saved
  • Streams in bb live
  • Shows in bb later
  • bbsend → queue · find Bot Chat
  • csend → dash
  • dash → queue · busy
  • dash → saved · idle: runs
  • queue → live · streams
  • saved → later · REST read
  • The bot's pinned bb thread is its Bot Chat, found by title each time. Nothing forks or gets copied.2
  • Conduit's own turns show in bb in two steps: your message at once, the reply when the turn ends.
6

What if Conduit holds the chat?

Diagram structure
  • bb sends send
  • Refused held
  • bb waits wait
  • Conduit lets go free
  • Gateway runs it adopt
  • Reply streams reply
  • send → held · send
  • held → wait · busy
  • wait → adopt · retry
  • free → adopt
  • adopt → reply · streams
  • bb shows "Open in another Hermes app: sends when it's free" and retries. It never creates a second chat.2
7

Which outside chats show up in bb?

Diagram structure
  • CLI, TUI local
  • Conduit conduit
  • Discord etc. chatapps
  • Cron, one-shot cron
  • Hermes chats saved
  • Not in bb out
  • Plugin sorts plugin
  • 30-day import import
  • Live mirror live
  • bb threads threads
  • Unread, push unread
  • local → saved
  • conduit → saved
  • chatapps → saved
  • cron → saved
  • saved → plugin · REST read
  • plugin → out
  • plugin → import · 30 days
  • plugin → live · new turns
  • import → threads
  • live → threads
  • live → unread · outside
  • In: every visible chat of an enabled bot from CLI, TUI, Desktop and Conduit. Each switch-on imports the last 30 days.3
  • Out: cron, one-shot and other sources, and Discord and other chat apps.
8

What does the per-bot switch do?

Diagram structure
  • Switch on on
  • Skill written skill
  • Prompt refresh refresh
  • Threads back back
  • 30-day import import
  • Switch off off
  • All archived archive
  • Skill deleted delete
  • Prompt refresh refresh2
  • Absent from bb absent
  • on → skill
  • skill → refresh
  • refresh → back
  • back → import
  • off → archive
  • archive → delete
  • delete → refresh2
  • refresh2 → absent
  • On: chat in bb, mirroring, and full access to bb through the bot's bb skill. The row shows the import count first.4
  • Off: the bot's threads are archived and its skill deleted. Every bot starts off.
9

What did the plan settle?

These are settled and reversible.9

  • The import runs at every switch-on, and the switch row shows its count.
  • CLI and TUI run every turn in the gateway; only Conduit's own turns are saved outside it.
  • History comes from Hermes' REST projection.
  • After the skill is written or deleted, the worker refreshes that bot's prompts.
  • The two rare Hermes race bugs are accepted and not filed upstream (D50).
